Body.Content:
Azure Monitor allows you to gain insight on your resources that are deployed and running in Azure. Monitor provides you with metrics which are near real-time performance indicators for resources in Azure to help you gain insight on what is going on. We are releasing new metrics in Azure Monitor that will help you understand your disk bursting performance better. These new metrics inform you of what performance you should expect from your Premium SSDs as well as indicate how much of your bursting credits the have used in the past.

Learn more.
